prose: A New York Times report on a Gallup survey across 37 countries: in 34 of them, positive sentiment about AI outweighed negative. The body was not captured (fetch error), so this summary rests on the headline.

On that basis: global public opinion on AI is far more favorable than Western discourse suggests - the angst is concentrated in a handful of rich countries while most of the world leans positive. Country rankings and demographics are unknown from the capture.
highlights: Gallup 37-country survey, via NYT: positive AI sentiment wins in 34
AI pessimism is a minority-global, Western-skewed phenomenon
Body not captured; rankings and demographic splits unknown
